verdict.rationale: Stripe's platform-level payouts docs confirm Instant Payouts (funds within ~30 minutes, any day) which lets a founder speed up cash access, and payouts flow through the standard Stripe balance system used by Terminal transactions. However, the evidence pack lacks any mention of a payout calendar/dashboard view showing exact land dates, or explicit next-day payout scheduling controls specific to Terminal. Missing for 10: dashboard/reporting evidence of tracking each payout's arrival date, explicit next-day payout option details, and confirmation this applies seamlessly to Terminal-collected funds.
